title: Pending Agent / Hook definitions
boundary: Keep original definitions pending by default. Supported static Agents can be explicitly adapted; Hooks and unsupported fields stay pending. Source commands are not executed and permissions are not expanded.
includeProject: Also inspect the explicitly trusted current project
pending: Original definition and field report; no execution authority
partial: Explicitly accept that some sources were not observed
sourceProblems: Some sources could not be inspected. Review the diagnostics before continuing.
review: Always requires review; no execution authority
bodyBoundary: Inert original bytes, read only on request. Commands, prompts and markup are not executed. Prepared, saved and undone records keep their original snapshot.
binary: This window contains binary data; it is not rendered.
noPlan: Review the static fields or original text before confirming the ordinary migration plan.
enableUnavailable: Keep original definitions pending by default. Explicitly adapted static Agents publish disabled and can be enabled separately through native skill management. Hooks are not enabled automatically.
updateRequired: This target needs an update for pending definition migration. No fallback or execution was attempted.
failed: The definition could not be read or inspected. Check the original target and record.
scanUnknown: Preview creation is unconfirmed. Read migration records; do not create another preview automatically.
parsed: Static fields parsed; still pending review
budget_exceeded: Parsing budget reached; original data retained
